A delta.json config_delta key that the base arm config does not carry must be registered here by a slug in the entry's own code_changes, be runner_live on the anchor tree, or be registered by a register('<key>', '<slug>', ...) line in patches-anchor/*.patch (bnhgq2/delta_keys.py; read as text). The applied tree's strict validator (classify_series.py) is the ground truth; this file only lets the generator fail early.
